**Policy Area**
- [ ] Target SDK & Android Version API Floor
- [ ] Permissions & Sensitive APIs (Photo Picker, Contacts, Location, etc.)
- [ ] Monetization & Play Billing
- [ ] Ads, AdMob & Consent (IAB TCF, UMP)
- [ ] Families, Children & COPPA
- [ ] Account Security, Enforcement & Appeals (180-Day Rule)
- [ ] Other

**Google Play Announcement Link**
URL to Google Play Console help center, Android Developers blog, or policy change log.

**Effective Enforcement Date**
When does Google begin enforcing this policy?

**Proposed Skill Delta**
How should the audit rules, classifications, or remediation code in `skills/google-play-policy-review/` be updated?
